notes.title: Cat Secretary Playtest - beta0.1 is now released!
notes.notes:
ey everyone,

As we move into 2025, we’ve shifted our development phase from production to polish. This means the story, levels, and systems are all in-game – though they aren’t polished or at the stage where we’re willing to show off the state of the game publicly.

Our goal for the remainder of development is to do just that – evaluate, rework, and ultimately polish this game to the point that we’re ready to showcase, and eventually put it on the Steam storefront. Our goal will be to have the Cat Secretary Demo, which contains the Prologue & Act One of the game, ready by June’s NextFest, and a plan to release the full game later in the second half of 2025.

If you have any issues or suggestions, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/zYCAVmhU]Discord[/url] and let us know!

Thanks for reading!

Kerrod & the CatSec Team

[h1]Patch notes for beta0.1[/h1]

[h2]Improved New Game Experience & Act One Story Updates[/h2]

The highest priority for this release was to polish the New Game Experience and Act One Story, including improved cinematics, updated dialogue, and ensuring completeness in tutorials. 
Several animations, props, and cinematics missed our b0.1 deadline due to pipeline issues – but there’s been a significant improvement across the board.

[list]
  [*]All Prologue scenes have been implemented with improved blocking, cameras, and dialogue
  [*]No Save Data' Main Menu map (Cat in Box outside Rain) & Pre-Game Scaffolding
  [*]New cinematic sequence of Cat entering the DOX building window
  [*]Tutorial Cards will now auto-trigger by default when Tutorials are enabled
  [*]New Collectable Tutorial in Museum
  [*]Redesign for 'Simple Tutorial' Push notifications (e.g. Press Q to Meow)
  [*]Implemented a Raccoon in Trash ‘Stealth Introduction’
  [*]Hiring Quiz UI improvements and additional questions
  [*]Museum story and prop improvements (still some placeholder props)
  [*]You now help Benjamin gain access to his mousehole, rather than just speak to him during the recovery of Obbo’s charging station.
  [*]“Room Unlock” for Lobby Management Tutorial Beat
  [*]Re-added Josiah’s Vault Password to the Floor 6 storeroom
  [*]After dating sim, Josiah is now in the lobby looking for his destined partner
[/list]

[h2]Environment & Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

As an ongoing effort, we’ll be improving the environment and QoL of the game based on internal and external feedback. 

[list]
  [*]All Floors now have higher walls for a less claustrophobic feel, more verticality opportunities
  [*]Play Menu redesign, spearheaded by our new UI/UX Designer
  [*]Introduced Quest Objectives into Cat Sense to help guide the player to the next objective
  [*]Improved Level layout for Business Biome
  [*]Obbo now has Sleep Face/VFX during Sleep State & unique Player Interactions
  [*]Lobby environment improvements
  [*]Fish tank will now populate with collected fish
  [*]Ensure Doors to Josiah’s office are closed pre-Dating Sim, open post-Dating Sim.
  [*]Implement "Free Water" Water Tank and "Box of Micro-transaction Parts" Props
  [*]More informative prompts for props only accessible in Late Evening
  [*]Remove/Clean up old Office Quests in Business Biome
  [*]Decoy Ability now has a cooldown shown before disappearing
  [*]Bot Overhead Notifiers have been reworked and improved
  [*]Abilities now have a rudimentary cooldown to avoid spamming
  [*]Status effects ('Chilled', 'Stunned', 'Scared') have been implemented in game, yet are awaiting assignment to certain abilities and enemy effects.
  [*]Props through the Lobby and Business floors have been audited so they’re actually touching things and not floating in mid-air.
  [*]The sweater prop in 'Catfish Your Boss' has a 'held' version, and a custom placement on floor if dropped by the player
  [*]Upgrading assets in the Lobby Management will trigger an Upgrade Camera, making a clearer moment and helping the player understand where it lives in the space.
[/list]

[h2]Lighting System[/h2]

We’ve overhauled our lighting system this release, which we hope adds to the atmosphere and style of the overall game. This includes a new Sky Box, Light changes based on time of day, dynamic shadows, and more!

[h2]Ongoing Stability & Tech Improvements[/h2]

Fixed:

[list]
  [*]Craig triggers incorrect dialogue at end of MQ1-1 (post-OQ)
  [*]Door Text (e.g. 'Access Lvl -2' should hide after opening door
  [*]MouseCorp Vendor UI - Benjamin’s Thoughts persist
  [*]Grabby Leave Location on Night 0 is still incorrect
  [*]Dox Museum Videos: they openings of each video are being cut-off
  [*]Interns remain and their good bye note does not spawn the day you hand in their Office Quest
  [*]MQ0-3 starting scene throws an error you end your day with a Fax Machine task
  [*]Museum collectible tutorial triggers on 2nd floor of museum
  [*]Obbo unlocking the museum dialogue doesn't always trigger so museum won't unlock
  [*]Walls not aligned on floor 6 with props along walls
  [*]Lobby management computer Obbo dialogue not despawning, multiple instances spawning, defocusing, etc
  [*]Allow Camera Override to stop collision when hiding in a box
  [*]Unlocking Bathroom in Lobby Management doesn't open the room up to the Player
  [*]Camera flip issue on start game
  [*]If you drop charging box while caught sometimes it despawns away forever
  [*]Morale is not increasing past Level 2
  [*]Bots consistently freeze after player pick up
  [*]Cats back legs freak out when picked up by grabby.
  [*]Fade In/Out is broken with new lighting
  [*]Numpad on fax machine doesn't work. Also need to rework instructions to make more clear
  [*]Update WBP_DialogueUI so FaceActor logic uses Generic NPC instead of NPC Master
  [*]MouseCorp Theme sometimes remaining after leaving vendor
  [*]Quest Objective is not always accurate on map/Cat Sense
  [*]Lobby Management success triggers too early on the VO
  [*]Quest Objectives should persist in Cat Sense and Minimap even after to reach their location (persist until quest objective is complete)
  [*]Obbo not reliably entering Sleep State
  [*]Marketing Studio computer needs to be a BP_Computer
  [*]Employee Computer Passwords won’t reliably auto-fill
  [*]Investigate Cook errors when packaging

  [*]Solve Elevators clipping through walls on multiple floors

  [*]DOX Bots should be NPCs instead of Enemies
  [*]Lock Player Movement during Dialogue Event ‘Camera Pan’

notes.title: Playtest Update alpha 0.10.1
notes.notes:
Hey all!

This release is being pushed for the next round of user testing -- which includes several fixes to the Prologue, updated environments, and updates to Act 1's questline (along with many other disconnected new content that you likely can't access yet!) 

Give the latest build a whirl and let us know your thoughts on the user testing survey or our discord! 

Cheers,
Kerrod

notes.title: Cat Secretary - Patch a0.9.1
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're working hard to bring user testers a new version of the Prologue that addresses the largest concerns outlined in our initial month of testing.

As we're moving so fast, it's not valuable to break down the patch notes as granular as before -- so instead I'll list high level changes here:

[list]
[*] New Prologue has been implemented. Play a new game to check out the new flow.
[*] A new Camera has been implemented to provide a more immersive experience. It's still experimental as we change much of the way our level environments work as well, so please keep that in mind. 
[*] New Tutorial cards assist in taking the load off character explanations. We're hoping to review the current scripts to stream line and keep only the best character moments.
[/list]
If you're reading this, thanks for keeping tabs on this project and I hope we can deliver more great updates soon!

Cheers,
Kerrod

notes.title: Stabilizing Act One - alpha0.7.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Happy Sunday! 

We’re pushing a patch that should fix a variety of bugs we found in the past week. Through these bug fixes, we can finally move Act One to Stable! There’s still plenty of content on its way for the Business biome and Act One, so we’re not finished there yet either, though you can now play the main story of Act One end to end, including the fun set piece to wrap it up!
We also made some big changes to Jump and Cat Sense, so check that out and let us know what you think!

More coming in the next couple of weeks so stay tuned and thank you for taking part in our playtest!

Best,
Kerrod & GSG
---

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Jump Rework[/b][list]
    [*]We’ve simplified the Jump mechanic to a simple jump in response to playtesting. 
    [*]We’ll continue to refine this jump based on incoming feedback, so it’s a singular satisfying element to the game.
    [*]We’re also planning to expand on the Jump mechanic using our Badge system, which will also see a polish push in Q4.
[/list]

[b]Cat Sense Updates[/b][list]
    [*]Cat Sense is now flagged in the tutorial so the player knows it’s available to them.
    [*]Cat Sense now also has a radius of effect, encouraging exploration while still making it easy for the player to know what’s around them.
    [*]Cat Sense now has its own animation when the cat focuses on their inner sense.
    [*]Cat Sense now has minimal Stamina cost, but the player remains still when in use.
[/list]

[b]Act One[/b][list]
    [*]Props throughout the Business biome and Act One have been polished.
    [*]Several new memos have been added to improve the Act’s experience.
    [*]Act One can now be played through its entirety without reliable issues.
[/list]

[b]Day Job[/b][list]
    [*]Fixed Issue where Tasks could be done at night
[/list]

[b]Environment/Levels[/b][list]
    [*]Added more Signage to Lobby
    [*]The Museum has new interactable placards, though some are still placeholders.
    [*]Moved Mop to Floor 3 bathroom as a band-aid to a larger inter-level prop issue that needs to be resolved.
    [*]Added Interact icon to Intern’s Memo
    [*]Fixed issue where player was locked out of controls when destorying Armand’s menus
[/list]

[b]HUD/UI[/b][list]
    [*]Fixed issues around player HUD/Quest visibility
    [*]Click-throughs have been improved and are more reliable, though some work is still to be done.
    [*]Tutorial Notifications have been updates with current design elements.
[/list]

[b]Map UI[/b][list]
    [*]Desk Locations now appear on the map
    [*]The Player Menu will now show the right map when on a floor
[/list]

[b]Tab Overlay[/b][list]
    [*]Updated TAB Overlay to include a ‘Short Wait’ allowing a player to skip from Evening to Late Night.
[/list]

 
[b]Known Issues[/b][list]
    [*]Interactables can currently be triggered through walls.
    [*]Animations of Quest HUD have been disabled as we resolve an animation conflict
    [*]Click-throughs do not work when on Computers.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest Starts Meow! alpha0.7.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First, I want to say thank you for helping us test Cat Secretary in its earliest playable form: the alpha playtest. Some of you have already playtested, and your feedback has already been incredibly valuable. Many suggestions have already been implemented, such as reducing stamina drain and improving player gating during the prologue. 

We're early into production for Cat Secretary, and your ongoing support through testing our builds, evaluating our design decisions, and providing us with your feedback will be critical to making this an amazing piece of art of which we can all be proud. 

Thanks again and please enjoy,
Kerrod
Studio Co-Lead

---

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]General Improvements[/b][list]
    [*]Stamina now drains significantly slower. We’ll continue to refine this throughout development as we revisit enemies, abilities, and stealth in general.
    [*]Notifications Rework, including Quest Headline, Line Items, Click-Through Notifications.
    [*]Improved, more dynamic Maps are partially implemented. You can access them via the Floor Plan on each floor. Eventually, this will replace the map in the MousePad.
    [*]Various Camera improvements, including where the Camera distance was juddering. This includes resolving wall collisions and updating the player's default zoom for a better camera view.
    [*]Updated CelShader, which leaves a cleaner shading and removes various issues such as wall light glitches and elevator shading issues.
    [*]Desk have been reworked, and are now non-interactable. Office Quests that had opportunities to place things inside desks are now trays on the desks.
[/list]

[b]Prologue Stability[/b][list]
    [*]Fix the issue where Benjamin’s dialogue would trigger when not in the ride-along sequence, breaking the prologue’s guide.
    [*]Fixed the issue where Players could sleep with Benjamin on their head.
    [*]MQ0-2 now starts after the morning cinematic with Obbo and Auggie.
[/list]

[b]Act One Stability[/b][list]
    [*]New VO moments for Act One.
    [*]Added dynamic doors to Josiah's office.
    [*]Added Josiah to his office during the evening.
    [*]Josiah’s Props are moved to their correct spots.
    [*]Added Door to Production Floors entrance.
    [*]Fix a bug preventing Josiah Dating Sim to start.
    [*]Added Loading Screen and Music to Dating Sim.
    [*]Vertical boxes were added back to Josiah's foyer. Removed all traversable interactions except the top one.
[/list]

[b]Various Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][list]
    [*]Various Dialogue and Typo fixes
    [*]The game now checks and removes NPCs from floors when they shouldn't exist
    [*]Added Interact flag to Door Keypads
    [*]Fixed the issue where the Jump icon shouldn't show up if you're already on the thing
    [*]Fixed issue where climbing through the Vent on the 3rd floor no-clipped to the bottom floor, breaking floor load state
    [*]Fixed Save Builder issue where Quest HUD would break on the first load
    [*]Fixed the issue where redirecting to Employee's Office Quest after profile completion was pointing to the wrong quest.
    [*]Fixed issue where you can switch focus while examining an object
    [*]When you pick up an item, the interact context UI should change to 'Put down' instead of 'Pick Up'
    [*]Updated Door to mail room on 2nd floor so you can't open it when it's blocked by a wet floor sign.
    [*]Fixed the placement of the intern report in the Mail Room
    [*]Fixed bug where MouseCorp vendor would re-open after delivering an office quest.
    [*]Latest emails are now at the top
    [*]Resolved Collision Errors
    [*]A new texture for PC
    [*]New Diane Photo that matches her face
    [*]Added stairs to the basement in the Lobby
    [*]Improved color clarity in Computer UI when it comes to option selections (e.g. Start Onboarding Quiz)
    [*]Moved Fax Machine to a corner of the Security Room to avoid accidentally interacting with it instead of Obbo
[/list]
